name: Thompson's Hillcrest Orchard
description: Thompson's Hillcrest Orchard grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 4682 250th Street East, MN. The farm is working, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
